task.description:
Apply the approved design at lib/letflow/design/iss-0467-direct-push-prohibition.md (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASS, see related_handoff_ids) to three files. This is a docs-only, non-code change -- no lib/ or priv/ Elixir source is touched. Do exactly what the design specifies, verbatim, at the exact insertion points it names:

1. docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md: insert the Section 2 blockquote paragraph (starting '**No direct push to `main`, ever...**') into the '## Precondition' section, at the exact location the design specifies -- immediately after the paragraph ending '...they also gate the actual merge call itself, not only the meaning of "green" the agent chooses to trust.' and before the paragraph beginning '**What "reported green" means here.**'. Copy the blockquote text verbatim (currently rendered as a markdown blockquote in the design doc -- render it the same way, or as a clearly-set-off paragraph, in GIT_MERGE.md, matching that file's existing prose style for emphasis paragraphs).

2. docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md: append the Section 3 blockquote paragraph (starting '**This exception governs review, not git mechanics...**') as a new paragraph at the end of '## 10. Sizing rule -- when ORCH may act directly', after the existing closing sentence '...When a check is ambiguous, it is a "no."'.

3. docs/migration/decisions/0018-branch-protection-posture.md: append a new dated subsection titled '## ISS-0467 resolution: direct-push prohibition (2026-09-05)' after the existing 'A real gap found live, after this record's own configuration' section and before 'What this record does not decide', per the design's Section 4 instructions. Content: state the option chosen (Option 2, prohibition -- not restrictions), a one-paragraph summary of the reasoning in the design's Section 1, and a pointer to the two textual changes (GIT_MERGE.md's Precondition addition, ORCHESTRATOR.md sec.10's closing paragraph) plus this design file's path (lib/letflow/design/iss-0467-direct-push-prohibition.md).

After editing all three files: run `mix format --check-formatted` (should be unaffected since these are .md files, but confirm no drift) and `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` to confirm nothing broke (expected: no change, since no .ex/.exs files are touched -- this is Unblock-Everything due diligence, not an expectation of finding anything). Do NOT run the full mix test suite yet -- that happens at Step Final per GIT_MERGE.md's own procedure. Commit your changes to the current branch (feature/WF03-ISS0467-20260904).

Do NOT touch anything outside these three files. Do NOT add an acceptance_criteria field to docs/issues/ISS-0467.yaml (out of scope, confirmed by the design's own Section 7 sourcing note).
acceptance_criteria: GIT_MERGE.md's Precondition section carries the new prohibition paragraph at the exact location specified, verbatim text
ORCHESTRATOR.md section 10 carries the new closing paragraph, verbatim text
docs/migration/decisions/0018-branch-protection-posture.md carries the new dated subsection in the correct location
mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes (sanity check only, no .ex/.exs files touched)
No file outside the three named above is modified
